Replay

Removing a Room participant

1 min readOdin × GodotPage source ↓

room_remove(&room, seat) resolves the authenticated member behind a live remote seat and queues coordinator removal. A successful call means queued, not removed. Read room.removal.phase: Queued, Waiting, Removed or Failed, with the target identity, epoch and error retained for presentation. Self-removal and non-host requests are refused. Planned handoff cannot begin while removal is pending.

Room renews its lease first if necessary, then uses a bounded removal timeout. After a lost reply it obtains fresh ordinary control state before retrying; a disabled roster entry resolves the operation as committed. Two failed attempts stop automatically. An old coordinator can therefore leave the operation failed while ordinary gameplay and lease renewal continue.

Before stepping authority gameplay, Room mirrors disabled token digests into the network ban ledger, removes their live bindings and stops checkpoint delivery to an invalid successor. This also runs after restoring a checkpoint older than the removal. Admission and successor selection remain constrained by the authenticated roster. A locally disabled member is marked room.removed, fenced and rejected.

For an uncoordinated Session, use the authority-side server_kick(&session.server, seat, ban=true). That ban belongs to the Session's checkpoint and has that checkpoint's durability window. server_ban_identity accepts an already authenticated token digest for trusted service integration.
